goals: Verify that all navigation and footer links return a 200 or 304 HTTP status code.
Verify that the sitemap, RSS feed, and all links within the sitemap return a successful HTTP status code.
activities: Retrieve all navigation links and log their count and URLs
Collect all navigation link URLs into a list
Iterate through each navigation link, navigate to it, and verify the response status is 200 or 304
Retrieve all footer links and log their count and URLs
Collect and validate all footer link URLs into a list
Iterate through each valid footer link, navigate to it, and verify the response status is 200 or 304
Verify the sitemap response status is 200
Verify the RSS feed response status is 200
Send a GET request to the sitemap ('/sitemap.xml')
Verify the sitemap response status is 200
Extract and parse the XML from the sitemap response to get all URLs
Iterate through each extracted URL, send a GET request, and record the response status
Annotate the test as flaky if a URL returns 404, or collect an error if it returns a status other than 200, 304, or 404
Attach the recorded URL statuses as a JSON file to the test report
Verify no errors were collected, throwing an exception otherwise
